map.算例：作业时间 240 min、完成 36 钩: Worked example: 240 min of operation, 36 cuts completed
map.单钩平均耗时 = 240 ÷ 36 = 6.67 min/钩；每小时钩数 = 3: Average time per cut = 240 ÷ 36 = 6.67 min per cut; cuts per hour = 36 ÷ 240 × 60 = 9.00 cuts/h; daily cut output = 9.00 × 20 = 180.00 cuts; the efficiency deviation from the 8 min per cut benchmark = (8 − 6.67) ÷ 8 × 100% = 16.67%, better than the benchmark.
map.「钩」是什么计量单位？: What kind of unit is a cut?
map.调车作业的基本计量单位，指一次牵出—推进—挂车（或甩车）的完整作业循环；摘挂列车: It is the basic unit of measurement for shunting work: one complete operating cycle of pulling out, pushing in and coupling or uncoupling a car. The counting basis for cuts may differ between pick-up and set-out trains and between marshalling operations, so unify it when comparing.
map.8 min/钩 的基准怎么用？: How is the 8 min per cut benchmark used?
map.这是平面牵出线作业的常见参考值。机械化驼峰、专用线直取、送取车组差异较大，宜用本: This is a common reference value for flat shunting lead track operations. Mechanised humps, direct access on dedicated lines and sending or collecting car groups differ considerably, so substitute the historical average or the surveyed value of your own station before comparing.
map.作业时间应包含哪些内容？: What should the operation time include?
map.应只含与调车直接相关的作业时间（牵出、推进、挂车、转线），不含等待机车、交接班与: It should include only the time directly related to shunting (pulling out, pushing in, coupling and changing tracks), excluding waiting for the locomotive, shift handover and shunting plan preparation; otherwise the time per cut is significantly overestimated.
